As a Senior Backend Engineer with six years of experience at Northwind Robotics, I have owned and scaled high-throughput systems, including an order-routing service built with TypeScript on Node.js and PostgreSQL, processing approximately 2 million events per day. My expertise in PostgreSQL includes schema design, query tuning, and logical replication, which I’ve applied to ensure data consistency and performance at scale. I have also led the successful migration of a monolithic system to an event-driven architecture using a Strangler Fig pattern over nine months, achieving zero customer-visible downtime and reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340 milliseconds.

In my role as Engineering Lead at Vertex Logistics, I managed a team of five engineers across dispatch and billing product lines, driving technical strategy and delivery. I leveraged Kubernetes and Terraform to streamline service deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability across environments. This experience strengthened my ability to lead cross-functional teams while maintaining high standards for system performance and operational excellence.

I am drawn to Ridgeway Defence’s mission and the opportunity to contribute to robust, secure backend systems. My track record in building scalable, resilient services—combined with hands-on experience in modern infrastructure and performance optimization—aligns directly with the demands of a Senior Backend Engineer role. I am confident in my ability to deliver impactful solutions in complex, mission-critical environments.
